pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'l'eau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. health
   B. bread
   C. sweets
   D. water

2. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'behind'? (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. derriere
   C. derière
   D. derriére

3. Which little word goes with 'magasin' (the shop)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

4. What does 'le cou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the leg
   B. the neck
   C. the hair
   D. the nose

5. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. Je m'appelle Amina.
   B. Je m'apelle Amina.
   C. je mappelle amina
   D. Je m appelle Amina

6. How do you say 'On Sunday, I rest.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

7. What does 'lundi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Monday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Saturday

8. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: What does he do on Saturday? (1 mark)
   A. He sings.
   B. He plays football.
   C. He goes to school.
   D. He goes to church.

9. How do you say 'the snow' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le vent
   B. l'orage
   C. la neige
   D. une inondation

10. Which little word goes with 'porte' (the door)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. les

11. Which little word goes with 'clé' (the key)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

12. How do you say 'You are welcome' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Tournez
   B. De rien
   C. Excusez-moi
   D. Allez

13. What does 'La télé est dans le salon.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the cat?
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. The TV is in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

14. Which month has an accent aigu on the first é? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. février
   C. juin
   D. mars

15. How do you say 'straight ahead' in French? (1 mark)
   A. près de
   B. à gauche
   C. tout droit
   D. à côté de

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. List three tips for reading French aloud clearly. (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into English: 'Où est le chat ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'Pleased to meet you!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'What is your name?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'C'est un gâteau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into French: 'This is my brother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — water
   l'eau means water.

2. A — derrière
   The correct spelling is derrière, with its accents.

3. A — le
   magasin is masculine, so we say le magasin.

4. B — the neck
   le cou means the neck.

5. A — Je m'appelle Amina.
   It has the apostrophe, double l, capital letters and a full stop.

6. B — Le dimanche, je me repose.
   On Sunday, I rest. in French is Le dimanche, je me repose.

7. B — Monday
   lundi means Monday.

8. B — He plays football.
   Le samedi, je joue au football.

9. C — la neige
   the snow in French is la neige.

10. B — la
   porte is feminine, so we say la porte.

11. D — la
   clé is feminine, so we say la clé.

12. B — De rien
   You are welcome in French is De rien.

13. C — The TV is in the living room.
   La télé est dans le salon. means The TV is in the living room.

14. B — février
   Février has é.

15. C — tout droit
   straight ahead in French is tout droit.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; do not say silent final letters; read in chunks and pause at commas; look at accents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Where is the cat?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enchanté !
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Comment tu t'appelles ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a cake.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: C'est mon frère.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.
